passages.title: 30번 지문
passages.text: The first human beings probably evolved in tropical regions where survival was possible without clothing. It is likely that they had very dark skin, because light skin would have given little protection against the burning rays of the sun. There is a debate about whether these people spread into other parts of the world or, instead, whether people developed independently in various parts of the world. Whichever the case, it is believed that in time they became capable of spreading out from Africa, eventually to most of the world. This was probably because their physical characteristics changed. For instance, early hominids probably did not walk upright, but when they developed that ability, they could travel more efficiently. More important, perhaps, was their development of tool making. With tools, they could hunt other animals, so they could consume more protein and fat than their low-energy vegetarian diet would have provided. Not only their bodies but also their brains would have been changed with more energy. The brain needs lots of energy to grow. As their diet expanded, hominids could physically and intellectually expand their territory.

questions.prompt: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: the debate over whether early humans lived exclusively in Africa
how physical and behavioral changes, including tool-making and diet, enabled early humans to expand their range and intelligence
the disadvantages of a vegetarian diet for early humans
the exact date early humans developed dark skin
why walking upright is unique to human beings
questions.explanation: 직립보행과 도구 제작(및 그로 인한 식단 변화)이 초기 인류의 활동 범위와 지능 발달을 가능하게 했다는 내용이다.

questions.prompt: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
choices: Light skin would have offered little protection against strong sunlight in tropical regions.
Tool-making allowed early humans to consume more protein and fat than a low-energy vegetarian diet would provide.
There is complete scientific consensus, with no debate, on whether humans spread from Africa or developed independently worldwide.
The brain requires a great deal of energy to grow.
Developing the ability to walk upright allowed for more efficient travel.
questions.explanation: 글에는 'There is a debate about whether...'라고 명시되어 있어 합의가 없음을 보여주므로 ③은 반대된다.
